title: R2E-Gym / SWEGEN
input: A supported repository with its upstream installation and test configuration.
native_output: Commit-derived executable coding tasks and reference patches.

conversion.approach: Translate existing task records into Harbor without inventing new instructions or grading rules.

known_limitations: Use supported repositories initially and keep source-specific setup changes explicit.

why_this_order: A separate commit-generation baseline with more repository-specific configuration.
